templates.title: Rehearsal: The Difficult Client
templates.description: Practice a difficult client conversation with an AI-played character who arrives in a different disposition every session.
templates.whatItShows: One client, four dispositions (cooperative, hostile, avoidant, ambivalent) drawn at random each playthrough — the AI conversation beat plus character variants doing rehearsal variety. Play it twice and compare.

templates.title: Counters that read affect
templates.description: A character whose meters mirror trust, fear and mood, plus choices whose effects move them. Replace the text; keep the wiring.
templates.whatItShows: Counter binding end to end: one ordinary counter beside three bound to sentiment, emotion level and mood. Bipolar meters grow outward from zero and show a phrase instead of a number. No choice writes to a counter — they change how the character feels, and the meters report it.

templates.title: The Oil Lamp — a museum story
templates.description: One object, three ways of seeing it: as a made thing, a used thing, and a taken thing. Swap in your own object; keep the structure.
templates.whatItShows: The Clean Editorial look (the first light theme), a hub that dims paths you have already taken, and in-text hyperlinks in the theme accent. Text-first and asset-free — it plays well on anything.

templates.title: 23:47 — a chat thriller
templates.description: A night train, a stranger’s phone on the seat opposite, and a thread you cannot put down. Keep Jo steady; choose her stop.
templates.whatItShows: The Dark Cinematic look, chat-bubble beats for scripted texting, and a live AI conversation in the middle — scripted bubbles hand off to the model and back for the ending you choose. The character dossier (traits, mood, texting style) is what makes the AI stay in voice.

templates.title: Ordinary Wonders — a GPS walk
templates.description: A pocket expedition played outdoors: three wonders scattered within 150 m of wherever you stand. Walk to one, find what nobody else has noticed, and name it.
templates.whatItShows: The Playful look and the full GPS loop with no authored coordinates: capture your position, scatter walkable targets around it (OpenStreetMap), a display map, arrival geofences, and honest skip exits. The player's answer comes back by name via text interpolation.
